reasoning: The paper analyses change from baseline per arm and the between-arm difference in change at each time point (S2.9.p1, Fig 3). Every participant exercised, so there is no non-exercise control: the time contrasts estimate the post-exercise response plus anything else that changes over the sampling day (repeated biopsy, fasting, time of day, the drink). The placebo arm is the cleanest estimate of the exercise response and is primary; the CP arm and the CP-vs-PLA difference in change are the paper's other planned estimands. Group-at-time cross-sectional contrasts are rejected because the paper compares changes, not post-exercise levels.

reasoning: Four biopsies per participant (S2.4.p1); participant is the repeated-measure unit and must be blocked. No batch or other covariate is recorded; all participants are male (S2.1.p1).
